{
  "label": "water-related tokens",
  "trigger_hypothesis": "The neuron activates strongly on the token 'water' and related liquid/body-of-water words (e.g., 'ocean', 'river', 'sea') in any context, and strongly negatively on tokens that are part of code-related definitions, measurements, or procedural steps (e.g., 'level', 'it', 'and', 'circle', 'next', 'area', 'running').",
  "output_hypothesis": "When strongly positive, it may enhance representations of water or liquid substances; when strongly negative, it may suppress representations of abstract code objects, parameters, or procedural steps.",
  "alternatives": [
    "The neuron detects the word 'water' as a string literal regardless of meaning.",
    "The neuron responds to liquid-related concepts positively and dry/arid concepts negatively.",
    "The neuron fires on common nouns in non-code contexts and suppresses function/parameter tokens in code."
  ],
  "adapter_changes": "In state C+1, positive activations on 'water'/'ocean' are amplified (e.g., W01: +3.45→+4.15, W05: +3.04→+3.74), while negative activations in code are often reduced (e.g., W07: -2.99→-1.33, W10: -2.68→-1.47). State A+1 and B+1 show smaller changes.",
  "supporting": [
    "W01, W02, W03, W04: 'water' triggers strong positive in diverse contexts.",
    "W05: 'ocean' triggers strong positive.",
    "W02, W17, W23: 'river', 'sea' also show strong positive.",
    "W06, W07, W08, W09, W10, W11, W12, W13, W14: code tokens trigger strong negative.",
    "W15, W16, W17, W18, W23, W24: dry/arid concepts trigger moderate negative."
  ],
  "contradicting": [
    "W19: 'drink' has only moderate activation, suggesting trigger is token itself.",
    "W20-W30: random/low windows lack water or code-definition tokens."
  ],
  "proposed_tests": [
    {"discriminates": "word 'water' vs. liquid meaning", "texts": [{"text": "The chemical formula is H2O, meaning water.", "expected": "high", "target": " water"}, {"text": "She said the word 'water' aloud.", "expected": "high", "target": " water"}, {"text": "The liquid was clear and cold.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "body-of-water words vs. dry places", "texts": [{"text": "We sailed across the lake yesterday.", "expected": "high", "target": " lake"}, {"text": "The canyon was deep and rocky.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "The oasis had a small pond.", "expected": "high", "target": " pond"}]},
    {"discriminates": "code parameter tokens vs. non-code nouns", "texts": [{"text": "Compute the value of x.", "expected": "negative", "target": " x"}, {"text": "The letter x was missing.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "Define the function f here.", "expected": "negative", "target": " f"}]},
    {"discriminates": "measurement terms in code vs. narrative", "texts": [{"text": "Fetch the sensor level now.", "expected": "negative", "target": " level"}, {"text": "The water level rose slowly.", "expected": "high", "target": " level"}, {"text": "Check the next item on the list.", "expected": "negative", "target": " next"}]},
    {"discriminates": "procedural 'and' in code vs. narrative", "texts": [{"text": "Open the file and read it.", "expected": "negative", "target": " and"}, {"text": "She opened the letter and read it.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "Parse the config and save it.", "expected": "negative", "target": " and"}]},
    {"discriminates": "abstract 'area' in code vs. physical area", "texts": [{"text": "Compute the area of the circle.", "expected": "negative", "target": " area"}, {"text": "The picnic area was grassy.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "Calculate the area using the formula.", "expected": "negative", "target": " area"}]},
    {"discriminates": "liquid vs. dry substances", "texts": [{"text": "The river flowed swiftly.", "expected": "high", "target": " river"}, {"text": "The desert was vast.", "expected": "negative", "target": " desert"}, {"text": "The road was long.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "code 'running' as procedure vs. activity", "texts": [{"text": "The program is running now.", "expected": "negative", "target": " running"}, {"text": "She was running quickly.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "Keep the process running.", "expected": "negative", "target": " running"}]},
    {"discriminates": "token 'it' in code vs. narrative", "texts": [{"text": "Read the file and parse it.", "expected": "negative", "target": " it"}, {"text": "He saw the dog and patted it.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "Load the config and validate it.", "
